notes: C10, C11 and C12 refer to the massless Dirac model in Supplementary Sec. II (not included in the main arXiv text); P18 and P5 partly capture them by asking to connect the model to the Dirac/topological band structure and to justify microscopically how the vacancy maps onto intra- and inter-band potentials. C19 asks to distinguish the order-parameter modulation from the charge-dipole mechanism in Kwon et al. (ref. 41); P16 asks to compare interpretations with Kwon et al. without explicitly naming charge dipoles, so it is graded 'partly'. C15 (dynamical Coulomb blockade in the double junction) is graded 'partly' against P12/P3's discussion of double-barrier defect charging.
